lesson-intro.text: An oak can live for hundreds of years. Ours has a thick trunk, three strong branches and a treetop like a big green cloud. See it spread out, then raise your own.

trunk-left.text: Begin at the ground on the left. Go up the trunk, then swing out and up to the left branch's tip.

trunk-right.text: Now a flat line for the foot. From its end, go up the trunk and swing out to the right.

left-branch.text: Round off the left branch's tip and come back down its inside to a sharp V.

middle-branch.text: The middle branch is a tall thumb. From the V, go up, round the top, and down to a second V.

right-branch.text: From that V, run up the inside of the right branch and round its tip to close it.

canopy-left.text: The treetop is a ring of big bumps. Start at the trunk on the left and bump your way up to the top.

canopy-right.text: Carry on down the right side, bump by bump, until you reach the trunk again.

green.text: Color the treetop green, all around the branches.

brown.text: Color the trunk and branches brown.

lesson-outro.text: From the ground to the highest bump, that oak is yours. Imagine the shade under it.
